checks.label: How Did You Hear About Us?
Are you eligible to work in the United States?
Will you now or in the future require sponsorship or assistance from ICF to maintain work eligibility in the U.S.?

Are you subject to any continuing employment restrictions or obligations with your current or former employer? These restrictions (for example, non-competition or non-solicitation clauses) are often found in offer letters, employment agreements, employee handbooks, policies or other documents you may have signed or acknowledged. If yes, further documentation may be requested. Note: Your response does not immediately disqualify you from employment with ICF. We ask so that ICF can manage potential contractual issues, if any.
Have you worked for ICF or any ICF subsidiary in the past?

If you are currently employed by the Government (federal, national, state, local, or military), have you notified your ethics official and recused yourself from involvement in any and all activities pertaining to ICF that may come before you until such time as either you or ICF has clearly rejected the possibility of your future employment with ICF and all discussions of such possible employment have ended?

emptyRequired: Are you closely related to or do you have a close personal relationship with anyone who currently works at ICF? Note: Your response does not immediately disqualify you from employment with ICF. We ask so that ICF can manage potential conflicts of interest, if any.

Are you a current or former Government Employee (federal, national, state, local, or military)? If yes, you may be asked to provide a letter from your agency’s ethics office or equivalent as part of the interview process.
